title: events: the side's own events of a day, or of one part of it
description: Each event as explain gives it as its node 0: its number (the number explain takes), day, pulse, kind, words and the units it names. It reads the side's own events and nothing else (decision 0156, rule 9).

day.description: The day asked for, or the day the clock is in.

pulse.description: The part of the day asked for: a pulse, or end for the events of the day that carry no pulse (those of its dusk and its end); null for the whole day.

begun.description: false for a day not yet begun: the list is then empty.
